serviceOutputName: Certified copy of a birth certificate

steps.requirement: Submit a completed birth certificate application

responsibleAgency.name: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene

steps.notes: Committed application forms: 'Application to Request an NYC Birth Certificate' (form:dohmh:unnumbered-be955853) and 'Premium Mail Service Birth Certificate Application' (form:dohmh:unnumbered-e515d15e); the premium form states Mail Service. Both extracted field-by-field.

steps.requirement: Order in person at the Office of Vital Records (appointment required)

responsibleAgency.name: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene

steps.notes: KA-01012: orders can be made online, by mail, or in person; all in-person orders require an appointment and same-day pickup is possible in some cases. Eligibility limits apply (record list, birth year 1920 or later).
